verse.verse_1: Behold, We revealed this (Qur'an) on the Night of Power.
verse.verse_2: And what do you know what the Night of Power is?
verse.verse_3: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months.
verse.verse_4: The angels along with the Spirit descend in it by the permission of their Lord with all kinds of decrees.
verse.verse_5: All peace is that night until the rise of dawn.
